Northwind Employee Handbook

Vacation. Every employee receives 25 days of paid vacation per calendar year. Unused vacation days can be carried over until March 31 of the following year.

Parental leave. Primary caregivers receive 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave. Secondary caregivers receive 6 weeks.

Learning budget. Each employee has an annual learning budget of 1,200 euros for courses, books and conferences.
